issues.legal_issue: A mortgagor may maintain a suit for redemption when a mortgagee in possession purchases the mortgaged property at a sale caused by the mortgagee’s breach of an obligation under the mortgage.
material_facts: The mortgagee took possession of the property under a usufructuary mortgage that required him to pay rent arrears if the mortgagor failed to do so.
The mortgagee failed to pay the arrears, and the property was sold for those arrears and purchased by the mortgagee.
The courts found that possession had been delivered under the mortgage and that the mortgage debt had not been discharged.
issues.conclusion: The mortgage was not extinguished by the sale, and the purchase was held in trust for the mortgagor. The suit for redemption was maintainable without first setting aside the sale.
issues.legal_principle: Section 90 of the Indian Trusts Act, 1882, read with illustration (c), requires a mortgagee who uses that position to gain an advantage in derogation of others’ rights to hold the advantage for their benefit. A mortgagee cannot profit from a default in an obligation under the mortgage. The principle that ‘once a mortgagee, always a mortgagee’ continues to apply until the mortgage is terminated by the parties, merger, or court order. Sidhakamal Nayan v. Bira Naik, AIR 1954 SC 336, was relied on. Malkarjun Bin Shidramappa Pasare v. Narhari Bin Shivappa, (1900) LR 27 IA 216, was distinguished because it did not concern a sale caused by the purchasing mortgagee’s own default; where a mortgagee buys in execution of its own decree with leave of court or under a decree obtained by a third party, the equity of redemption may instead be extinguished.

rule.if: redemption_suit and mortgagee_in_possession and mortgagee_obligated_to_pay_rent_arrears and mortgagee_default_caused_sale and mortgagee_purchased_sale_property

predicates.redemption_suit: The proceeding is a suit by a mortgagor or the mortgagor’s successor seeking redemption of a mortgage.
predicates.mortgagee_in_possession: The mortgagee took possession of the property under the mortgage.
predicates.mortgagee_obligated_to_pay_rent_arrears: The mortgage required the mortgagee to pay rent arrears if the mortgagor failed to pay them.
predicates.mortgagee_default_caused_sale: The mortgagee failed to perform that obligation, and the failure led to a sale of the mortgaged property for the arrears.
predicates.mortgagee_purchased_sale_property: The mortgagee purchased the property at that sale.

issues.definition: When a redemption suit concerns property bought at a sale caused by the purchasing mortgagee’s breach of an obligation while in possession, the suit may proceed without first setting aside the sale.
